messages:
rina_cs: Quick heads-up — PineLabs renewal landed on my desk. Renewal date 2026-06-12. They asked if we can do 24mo at 10% off and need a PO in by EOM. Any major blockers on term/pricing change?

jules_ae: Got the note. Customer is happy with product, but procurement wants consolidated billing and a single invoice for the 24mo term. They also asked for Net45 payment terms instead of Net30.

samir_fin: Net45 is fine from finance side but we need to confirm VAT handling for their region (India). Also we require PO + signed amendment before provisioning reserved capacity.

priya_legal: We can approve 24mo + 10% off. I'll draft an amendment (standard addendum) — will include revised term, price, billing cadence, and Net45. Need one exec sig on file and customer signature via DocuSign.

rina_cs: Can you drop the amendment draft here when ready? I can run a short enablement for their ops team after signature. Customer asked for onboarding credits applied to first invoice — can we reflect that in the amendment?

priya_legal: Yes, include a line: "One-time onboarding credit of $4,000 applied to invoice #1." I'll add the clause. Draft in a few hours.

jules_ae: I'll coordinate PO flow with their procurement lead (cc'd in email). Probable timeline: PO by 05/27, signature same week. If PO slips, we should offer a 10-business-day grace for provisioning.

samir_fin: Flag: if PO arrives without VAT ID, finance will need to raise a tax question. Rina, can you confirm they will provide GSTIN?

rina_cs: Pinged their FinOps (via email) — they said they'll confirm GSTIN by COB tomorrow.

docusign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: AMND-PINELABS-179860. Waiting for signer list from legal.

priya_legal: Added signer list and clause IDs. Envelope ready once I set the signature block for exec.

jules_ae: For rollout: after signature + PO, schedule enablement onboarding (30m technical + 30m billing ops). Rina, I'll book with their team for week of 6/1.

samir_fin: Once PO and GSTIN are in, I'll approve invoicing terms. If VAT issue persists, finance will require prepayment for first invoice.

rina_cs: Noted. Also capturing renewal feedback: they asked for clearer token-cost per-route breakdown in Console — I'll create a quick doc and include it with the amendment.

priya_legal: Amendment draft uploaded to the thread: AMND-PINELABS-2026-v1. Small ask: keep the discount conditional on signing the 24mo term (no retro discounts).

rina_cs: Perfect. I'll confirm GSTIN tomorrow and update once PO lands. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

docusign_bot: Envelope AMND-PINELABS-179860 sent to PineLabs exec on 2026-05-20 15:42 UTC.
